message: No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read only from local file paths with no remote fetching, and there are no checksum, signature, or authentication checks anywhere in the pipeline.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only normalizes label strings (e.g., lowercasing, stripping, mapping 'backdoor' to 'backdoors') but never validates label values against an expected set, compares label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code reads CSVs, applies type converters, and converts to HDF5, but performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs against poisoned data.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads data files (CSV/HDF5) and references joblib's dump/load in imports, but no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision is performed when loading any serialized model or weights.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor defense mechanisms such as trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection are present anywhere in the code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanisms are imported or used in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or attack methods (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are imported or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolation mechanism, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics being used; the code only loads a dataframe and returns without performing any evaluation.

No detected input sanitization: The inference path reads data directly from a file via get_clean_dataframe_from_file without any shape, range, schema, or malformed-input validation before passing it onward.
No detected output bounds checks: No model output is produced or checked in the visible inference path; main() only loads and returns a dataframe with no probability, NaN, or threshold guards.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a tabular network-traffic classifier, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
